question: How many fixed empirical response directions per verified reader preserve the writer-free two-reader program, and is the discarded response complement causally inert?
novelty: The prior result replays full row-matched response tensors. No prior experiment fits fixed response bases at block9 H1/H4 and block11 H3, installs their projections jointly, and tests the discarded complements in the live suffix.

frozen_design.population: fresh A1 even rows fit; fresh A1 odd rows held out; all fresh A2 rows transfer
frozen_design.reader_vectors: changed-minus-base head output at final query, concatenated within block9 H1/H4 (256 coordinates) and block11 H3 (128 coordinates)
frozen_design.basis: uncentered thin SVD independently per reader on the 16 A1-even response rows; projector sign is irrelevant; ranks 1, 2, and 4
frozen_design.metrics: heldout and A2 tensor explained energy per reader; joint causal recovery as a fraction of the full-response arm; donorward fraction
frozen_design.fitted_parameters: basis coordinates only: rank*(256+128), no fitted scalar or model update

predictions.pred_a_authority_and_exact_instrument: capture reconstruction and identity errors <=5e-4; full response recurs within 0.03 of the registered heldout/A2 endpoints
predictions.pred_b_rank4_program_sufficient: rank4 joint response retains [0.85,1.15] of full-response recovery and is donorward on >=0.90 of rows in both heldout and A2
predictions.pred_c_rank4_complement_inert: rank4 complement has absolute fraction <=0.20 of full-response recovery in both heldout and A2
predictions.pred_d_monotone_tensor_compression: explained energy is nondecreasing from rank1 to rank2 to rank4 for each reader and evaluation split
predictions.pred_e_rank_price_is_exact: 32 forwards, 720 examples, 336 unique arm-row records, zero backwards/updates

terminal_rules.invalid: authority, identity, reconstruction, recurrence, coverage, finiteness, or price fails
terminal_rules.higher_rank_needed: valid experiment but rank4 is not causally sufficient or its complement remains material
terminal_rules.null: valid rank4 projection fails to carry a consistently donorward response

interpretation_limits: Projection coefficients remain row-specific oracle coefficients; this tests quotient dimension, not yet coefficient prediction.
SVD minimizes response-tensor squared error, while causal recovery is the decisive metric.
The two readers retain separate bases because a single cross-layer projector is not a coherent live intervention.
